name: Fury 3 Vita
author: StaticLift
description: A static recompilation of Microsoft Fury3 (1995), a flight shooter, running natively on the PS Vita with no emulator. It includes all eight planets, the 24-mission campaign, GPU rendering, music, cutscenes, one save slot and a planet select on the title screen. Mods load through the game's own pod.ini file.
